description: This PHP class generates and manages the autoload.php file for a Drupal project, including creating the file with correct relative paths and checking if it has been committed to version control.

classes.name: GenerateAutoloadReferenceFile
classes.description: A final class with static methods to generate and verify the autoload.php file for Drupal projects.

methods.name: generateAutoload
methods.description: Creates the autoload.php file at the specified location with the correct relative path to the autoloader.

methods.name: autoloadFileCommitted
methods.description: Checks if the autoload.php file exists and has been committed to version control.

methods.name: autoloadPath
methods.description: Generates a ScaffoldFilePath object for the autoload.php file based on package name and web root.

methods.name: autoLoadContents
methods.description: Builds the PHP contents for the autoload.php file, including the relative path to the autoloader.
